correctness.rationale: Normality of the subgroup in Gamma_0(3) follows from two central CRT factors. The quotient is Q8 x PSL2(F5), order 5760. Exactly two cusps and one order-three elliptic point on X_0(3) give branch indices 40,40,3 by direct conjugated-parabolic computations and torsion-freeness of Gamma. The index/genus and canonical j passport satisfy Riemann--Hurwitz. The local core calculation gives Q8 x A4 x A5 and a degree-69120 regular Galois closure with 576 cusps, genus 5473. Independent exact Python assertions reproduce core sizes, local primitive-vector orbits, widths, orders and formulas. Full proof with scope and nonclaims is in RESULT.md.
